verdict.rationale: Relay's own docs state it can 'Capture receipts, categorize expenses in real time, and sync everything to your accounting software automatically' (relay-docs-3), directly matching the story, but there's no detail on the actual capture mechanism (e.g., automatic prompt at time of swipe vs. manual photo upload) and no independent or hands-on corroboration of this specific feature working seamlessly. Missing for 10: independent/community validation of the receipt-capture flow, technical detail on how capture is triggered at point-of-sale, and any evidence it truly requires zero manual entry.
